newsitem.title: INDIA: Calcutta bourse to start on-line trade on Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: Calcutta bourse to start on-line trade on Feb 20.

text.p: The Calcutta Stock Exchange (CSE) will begin screen-based trade on February 20, the bourse said in a statement.
Initially, it will start the on-line trade in 101 shares of the B-group, it said.
"The scrips once put into the on-line trading system will cease to get traded in the existing out-cry system," the statement said.
